prompt: I need a maintenance script for our model-selection watchdog. Please update the repository so that the guard reliably parses `openclaw models status` output, prefers the healthiest Anti-Gravity model, and falls back to `google/gemini-3-flash-preview` when every AG model is below 20%. Keep the behavior quiet when no switch is needed, but log a clear message when a switch happens. Also make the threshold and fallback model easy to tune in `guard.js`.
